The open‑market repurchases under the dividend reinvestment and direct stock purchase plan accounted for 42,749 of the 45,686 shares bought in Q4 2004.  
\[
\frac{42,749}{45,686}\times100\approx 93.55\%
\]  
**93.55 %** of the shares were repurchased in open‑market transactions under the plan. [D77_C5]
